about: OpenVibe's public roadmap: the plain-language summary of what is being built next, synced into the Roadmap space on openvibe.community at every boot (server/forum/roadmap.js). Edit this file to change the roadmap; each item keeps its thread (by key), so replies and votes stay with it.

items.title: OpenVibe.Chat, on its own site
items.summary: Global chat, direct messages, rooms and your chat settings at [openvibe.chat](https://openvibe.chat), working with or without JavaScript and even while Live is down. Opened on 24 September 2026; rooms followed on 25 September.

items.title: OpenRe.Stream: stream once, restream everywhere
items.summary: Send your stream to one ingest and let OpenRe.Stream forward it to every platform, with keys, destinations and output health in one place. The service is running; moving Live's stream slots onto it needs the new ingest address and a short switch-over window for each broadcaster.

items.title: OpenVibe.Tips and OpenVibe.VIP
items.summary: Tips, goals and paid messages for creators, and creator memberships with perks recognised on every site. Both are built; they open once all money moves through the network's billing ledger, so every tip and membership is recorded exactly once.

items.title: OpenVibe.News and OpenVibe.Reviews
items.summary: Source-backed stories with citations and several perspectives, and reviews gathered with their sources. They open when their source lists have been reviewed: nothing is published without a source.

items.title: OpenVibe.Deals and OpenVibe.Coupons
items.summary: Community deals with the source, price and freshness always shown, and coupon codes checked by the people who use them.

items.title: OpenVibe.Trade: watchlists and alerts
items.summary: Watchlists, sourced market context and alerts. Information only: no custody and no orders.

items.title: OpenVibe.Host
items.summary: First the network's own deployment tooling in the open, then simple hosting for community sites, bots and mods.

items.title: Voice and video calls in OpenVibe.Chat
items.summary: Calls move from Live into OpenVibe.Chat, so rooms and direct messages can turn into a call on any site.

items.title: Images on Community posts
items.summary: Attach up to four images to a thread or a reply, with or without JavaScript. They are stored in OpenVibe.Media like every other upload, with location and camera details removed first.

items.title: Categories, feature requests and this roadmap
items.summary: Feedback has categories (ideas, bugs, questions), requests you can vote on, and a status staff keep up to date. This Roadmap space shows what is being built, with a thread for every item.

items.title: Forum boards, ratings and pastes in posts
items.summary: Spaces can be classic forum boards, like vBulletin or SMF: a board index, topic tables with replies, views and the last post, and author panels beside every post with quotes. Or they can be feeds ranked by votes. Rate any post the Facepunch way (Agree, Winner, Funny, Informative, Friendly, Sympathy, Dumb, Disgusting, Bad reading, Late), attach pastes and images, and crosspost a thread from a forum to a feed.

items.title: See, download and delete your data
items.summary: The AI & Data tab on your account lists what OpenVibe sites keep with your account, and lets you download it or delete any of it. Next: one export with everything from every site, and account deletion with a grace period.

items.title: AI that writes the way you ask
items.summary: Set a style, a length and a perspective once on your account, and OpenVibe AI follows them whenever it writes something for you. Turn off "Keep what I ask AI" and it keeps neither your request nor a reusable copy of the answer.

items.title: Favourite tools on every device
items.summary: Star a tool on openvibe.tools or on your account page, and it leads your tools everywhere you sign in.

items.title: Sign out everywhere means everywhere
items.summary: Signing out everywhere, changing your password or a ban now reaches every OpenVibe site within seconds: older sign-ins stop working and open chat and game connections close.

items.title: Rename your channel without breaking links
items.summary: When you change your username, links to your old channel address forward to the new one, and nobody else can take your old name for six months.

items.title: Every VOD and clip checked and recoverable
items.summary: Recordings and clips are stored in more than one place and checked regularly. A video now plays only once a stored copy has been checked, holds keep evidence from being deleted or moved (clips follow their recording), and a monthly report lists stray files without touching them. Still to come: splitting very long recordings into parts, and repairing the few copies known to be damaged.

items.title: Community threads on Discord, and back
items.summary: New threads are already announced on Discord. Next: replies both ways, edits and deletions kept in step, with no loops.
